### A Shoot from Jesse's Stump
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/shoot-jesses-stump
Passage: Isaiah 11:1-11
Points:
- The stump represents the devastating decline and apparent death of David's royal dynasty under divine judgment.
- Isaiah names Jesse rather than David to highlight the Messiah's lowly roots as well as His supreme significance.
- God preserved life within the severed tree so that a tender shoot would emerge and grow into a glorious kingdom.
- The Spirit of the Lord rests upon this King, endowing Him with divine wisdom, understanding, and strength.
- Christ exercises flawless equity on behalf of the poor, providing hope for believers navigating an opposing culture.

### A Prayer for Those Longing for Peace in Creation
Author: Sophia Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-those-longing-for-peace-in-creation.html
Passage: Isaiah 11:6-9
Points:
- The prophet's portrayal of predators resting alongside prey overturns our normal fear of nature's deadliness.
- Radical harmony replaces hostility, allowing a vulnerable child to lead dangerous beasts unharmed.
- Modern bonds with animals offer small previews of the redeemed cosmic peace to come.
- The future kingdom will put an end to all violence as divine knowledge saturates the earth.
- Believers living in the present age are called to wait faithfully while actively cultivating peace.

### An Advent Prayer to Our Prince of Peace
Author: Lisa Appelo
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/christmas-devotionals/advent-prayer-peace-christmas-devotional-dec-16.html
Passage: Isaiah 11:1-2
Points:
- Just as green growth can emerge from a cut tree, God raised the Messiah out of an apparently dead royal line.
- Isaiah prophesied centuries in advance that the Branch would descend from the ancestral roots of Jesse.
- Jesus did not come in military conquest or worldly majesty, but entered our world in poverty and humility.
- The Holy Spirit rested upon Christ with wisdom, counsel, knowledge, and reverence for God.
- Believers are invited to release control over their daily lives and yield completely to the Prince of Peace.

### Praying the Names of God - October 7
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-october-18.html
Passage: Isaiah 11:1-9
Points:
- While earthly dynasties decline over time, God remains the ultimate King over the entire universe.
- Jesus fulfills the prophetic hope by establishing an enduring kingdom marked by righteousness and peace.
- Isaiah describes a renewed creation where enmity ceases and the weak and strong coexist in safety.
- Contrasting today's world with Isaiah's prophetic promise inspires Christians to pray for God's kingdom to come.
- Followers of Christ are challenged to surrender self-interest and participate in His redemptive work.
